(4) It tags emotions 'isolation' and 'hesitation' where the reference identifies none, which constitutes invented interpretation. (5) The evidence descriptions mention vertical and horizontal shifting but never note the enlargement of the figures, which is the primary observable change across the ordered frames. The continuity assessment is correct, and the rectangle prop is correctly tracked. Overall, the analysis gets several structural elements right but mischaracterizes the dominant motion pattern and invents tone/emotion content not supported by the frames."}
